subject: {first_name}, I built this after one too many "they're due" takes
preview_text: Calibrated picks on moneyline, spread, and totals — verify every result.
body_paragraphs: Every game night, the same scene: a group chat full of hot takes — "they're due," "back-to-back doesn't matter," "I just feel a blowout." Nobody checking injuries, rest days, or what the numbers actually say.

I built Predictify NBA because basketball arguments shouldn't be won by whoever talks loudest. We wanted forecasts you can pressure-test: injuries, pace, back-to-backs, and a calibrated confidence score on moneyline, spread, totals, and props.

A friend of ours learned this the hard way on a national TV night. The model flagged a favorite at 58% confidence — basically a coin flip. He ignored it, went with gut feel, and lost the argument and the bet. Two weeks later he opened a pick in our highest-confidence band (80%+ tier), read the breakdown, and called it before tipoff. Same friend. Different process.
That's why we publish every result — wins and losses — so you can verify the track record yourself, game by game. No hidden picks. No rewriting history after the final buzzer.
Your next step takes about 30 seconds: open tonight's slate, pick one game, and read the reasoning before you lock in your call.
P.S. We're not a bookmaker. No guaranteed wins — just transparent forecasts and a record you can check.
